forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. The June 17 MoU had collapsed before this forecast's horizon window opened. On September 1 at the SCO summit, President Pezeshkian stated 'if the US returns to its commitments in the MoU, Iran will immediately reciprocate' — explicitly conditional, not a public commitment to mediated negotiations. No Araghchi/SNSC unconditional commitment was issued before EOD September 6. Ambiguity rule: conditional offer with US acceptance not forthcoming = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Resolved NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO (retroactively effective July 17, 2026 — DA structural fail note applied). Knesset dissolved July 17 at natural end of four-year term with coalition holding 61/120 seats intact. No roll-call vote confirmed majority loss; no early dissolution announced. YES conditions permanently foreclosed: no Knesset exists to hold a roll-call vote. NO branch satisfied: coalition survived to mandatory election date with 61+ seats. Effective resolution date July 17; formal retirement processed October 6.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.

forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

forecasts.question: Will Likud win the most Knesset seats (seat plurality) in the October 27, 2026 Israeli election?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE (33-day gap). Five-poll average Sep-Oct 2026: Yashar 23.6 avg seats vs Likud 21.8. Yashar leads in four of five surveys (Kan News 25-21, Maariv, Walla, Haaretz); i24NEWS outlier shows Likud 27-22. Analyst proposed 0.36; DA proposed 0.37. Judge accepted 0.37: wartime incumbency effect in Israeli elections (voters historically break toward security-hardline incumbent in closing weeks under active conflict) and opposition arithmetic difficulty (opposition bloc near 52-54/120 requires Arab party alignment historically unreliable) create a structural Likud floor not fully captured in raw polling average. DA data conflict noted (KAN poll figure discrepancy flagged for human review).
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if official Knesset election results published by the Israeli Central Elections Committee show Likud winning more seats than any other single party in the October 27, 2026 election.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Israeli Central Elections Committee official results, carried by Times of Israel/Haaretz/Reuters/AP.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Likud and one other party tie on seats: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO (no plurality). Exit polls alone do not resolve; official preliminary results suffice if published before EOD Oct 27. If election legally postponed past EOD Oct 27 by Knesset vote or High Court order: AMBIGUOUS — carry forward to revised date.

forecasts.question: Will the United States conduct new airstrikes or missile strikes on internationally recognized Iranian territory after October 6 and before December 5, 2026?
